guidebook.intro: Luganda has no “-er” or “-est”. Instead, things “surpass” each other with the verb **okusinga**.

tips.title: Surpassing
body: For “bigger than”, say the adjective and add **okusinga** (to surpass): **Enjovu nnene okusinga ente**.

For “the most”, the thing itself surpasses, in a quality noun: **asinga obuwanvu** (surpasses in height = the tallest), **ekisinga obulungi** (the one that surpasses in goodness = the best). Quality nouns start with **obu-**: **obunene** (size), **obuwanvu** (height), **obulungi** (goodness).

culture.title: Modest comparisons
body: Boasting that you are **asinga** at something can seem rude. People prefer to praise others: **Ggwe osinga!** (you’re the best!) is a warm compliment.
